# German playable lexicon expanded from hunspell de_DE_frami (LibreOffice dictionaries de @ 75f5dff8c972fff4a32e4ea8434722c277f02a3f).
# The German edition has A-Z plus AE-, OE- and UE-umlaut TILES and no eszett tile, so:
#   * eszett is written 'ss' -- Unicode full case folding already does this;
#   * a-umlaut, o-umlaut and u-umlaut are PRESERVED, because each has its own tile;
#   * every other marked letter (loanword accents) is folded to its base letter.
# So this file lists playable TILE SEQUENCES: 'strasse' and 'attache' are here,
# 'kaese' is not -- 'k' + a-umlaut + 'se' is.
# Compound words are not enumerated; unmunch expands affixes, not compounding.
# Not an official tournament list.
